_help: Set approved: true only for streamers who gave permission (clipping program or written yes); put the proof in 'permission'. facecam = x:y:w:h in the source video's pixels. With TWITCH_CLIENT_ID/SECRET set, the daily scan also finds top streamers on its own; this list then only decides who is approved. top_games = how many of the top gaming categories to scan; categories = fixed list instead (e.g. ["Grand Theft Auto VI"]).
